meta.title: Novel Fish
meta.description: Append a local novel passage after the real thought when actively expanding native Thinking.

chat.noBook: Select a book under Settings → General → Novel Fish first.
chat.switchHint: Collapse and actively expand this region to read from the current progress.
chat.readError: The passage could not be loaded; progress did not change.
chat.retry: Collapse and actively expand this region to retry.

settings.title: Novel Fish
settings.description: Import and select a book, then select a native region type. Active expansion keeps the real thought and appends a novel passage after it; nothing is sent to the model.
settings.typeHint: Applies to native Thinking regions in any chat, without selecting turns or steps. A different region's first active expansion continues reading. Only Thinking is currently supported; tool logs and answers are untouched.
settings.emptyLibrary: Import an EPUB, TXT, or MD file to begin.
settings.presetHint: Choose presets without typing; an input appears only when Custom is selected.
settings.removeConfirm: Delete {title} and its local reading progress?
